method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in one module, the dates in another, the questions in two seat modules importing them; one regulative rule (s 31(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seats: the will-maker (testator): the individual making, changing or revoking a will in Victoria, including a minor and a person whose Court-authorised will was made while they lacked capacity (wills-seat.l4)

the person with an interest in a deceased person's will: a beneficiary, spouse, domestic partner, child or other relative, a person entitled on intestacy, a creditor, and the relative applying for a Court-authorised will for someone without capacity (wills-seat-family.l4)
